name: Gantry Walker
behaviour: Slow neon-city mini-boss that respawns 110 s after it falls. Stomps up close, fires a four-rocket salvo down a wide telegraphed lane at range, and at 60% health sounds a siren that sends every machine hunting and calls two gyrocopters. Scavengers attack it too. Drops boosts and gear.
look: Four-metre bipedal cargo walker with a plated cab, twin rocket pods, a grabbing arm and a red siren beacon.
